messages:
viv: FYI found a bad pattern in the sample-app Docker setup  docker-compose.yml instructs people to paste their API key into the compose file and check it in. SUP-4991.

omar: whoa. where is that?

viv: repos/mobile-samples/voice/README.md points to docker-compose.example.yml which shows: 

``viv: version: '3.7'
services:
  app:
    image: redwood/sample-voice
    environment:
      - REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-EXAMPLETOKEN  # DO NOT COMMIT ACTUAL KEYS
``

viv: then the README suggests copy -> paste to docker-compose.yml. People do that and push live tokens.

kelly: oof. also the sample app uses raw HTTP in container entrypoint and shows no timeout or retry guidance. folks assume "container works" and ship it.

omar: immediate fixes: 1) replace literal in examples with ${REDWOOD_API_KEY} and show .env usage in README, 2) add a note to prefer Docker secrets or env var injection in CI, 3) add safe raw-http snippet that sets timeouts and error handling, and 4) promote SDK usage inside the container (SDK handles pooling + retries).

kelly: example change proposal in README:

``kelly: # .env (do not commit)
REDWOOD_API_KEY=your_api_key_here

# docker-compose.yml
services:
  app:
    env_file: .env
    # OR use docker secrets for production
``

kelly: and add a short container snippet showing how to read from env securely and avoid logging the key.

omar: parity note: the container raw HTTP example calls /v1/stream without showing how to handle transient 429s. We should add a one-paragraph: "Why prefer the SDK in containers" that lists automatic retries for 429/5xx, connection pooling, and how to disable retries for one-off batch jobs (retries: 0).

viv: can we also add a docs CI check for docker-compose files that contain `REDWOOD_API_KEY=` or `sk-` patterns? simple grep in docs pipeline would catch copy/paste.

linter-bot: Suggestion: docs CI rule: `grep -R --exclude-dir=node_modules -E "REDWOOD_API_KEY\s*=|sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{6,}" docs/ samples/ || exit 1`. Also add a pre-commit sample that warns if .env is tracked.

kelly: I'll open a PR that: replaces the hardcoded snippet, adds .env example + docker secrets note, includes a safe raw-http example with timeouts, and an SDK example showing opt-out for retries. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/834   title: "samples/voice: remove hardcoded key from docker-compose example, add secrets + SDK guidance"

docs-bot: New PR opened by kelly: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/834   title: "samples/voice: remove hardcoded key from docker-compose example, add secrets + SDK guidance"

omar: after merge ping security to rotate the leaked key and support to close SUP-4991. Also add a short entry to the docs author checklist: "Never recommend copying tokens into compose files; prefer .env (local) or secrets (prod)."

viv: thanks  this one felt like low-hanging fruit but high risk. :lock:
